RAY_MOD_EVENT_ABANDONED_MINE.title: Abandoned Mine
RAY_MOD_EVENT_ABANDONED_MINE.pages.INITI:
The winch is still turning, its cable hanging into darkness.

The ventilation pipe snapped long ago, yet the footprints around the collar are fresh. Someone is still working this shaft.

A pitsinker's rule: send the sand beast down first.
Rope down yourself. Take [red]{Damage}[/red] damage, but the deep vein is untouched. Gain [blue]{MineGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
RAY_MOD_EVENT_ABANDONED_MINE.pages.SCOUT:
It slides down the cable, stops at thirty meters, and calls back up at you.

When it climbs out, it is carrying a chunk of raw ore—far too pure for an abandoned shaft.

Gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
RAY_MOD_EVENT_ABANDONED_MINE.pages.DESCE:
Two meters above the bottom, the supports give way.

Rubble pins you into the drift, and it takes a while to dig yourself out.

But the trip was not wasted: the deepest vein is still there, untouched.

Gain [blue]{MineGold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
